title: Entrance Fee Agreement Pre-Occupancy Refund: How the Amount Is Figured
content:
**Refund amount.** The refund on a resident's own cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy is the money received on the agreement (every deposit and balance payment entered on its ledger) less the processing fee entered on its ledger, paid in one payment to the resident by refund check mailed to the address on file. The amount is taken to the cent, rounded half up.

## What enters the figure

| Component | Read from | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| Deposit payments | Ledger of the agreement | Added |
| Balance payments | Ledger of the agreement | Added |
| Processing fee entered on the cancellation | Ledger of the agreement | Subtracted |

The entrance fee stated in the agreement does not enter the figure; only money actually received does.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)

| Case | Deposit payments | Balance payments | Processing fee entered | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancelled with only the deposit paid | 34090.00 | 0.00 | 6818.00 | 27272.00 |
| Cancelled after the balance was paid | 37765.00 | 339885.00 | 7553.00 | 370097.00 |

## Points of reading

- The refund is one payment; it is not split between instruments or dates.
- The payee is the resident, and the check goes to the address on file.
